description: List the effects — amendments, repeals, revocations, commencements, modifications — recorded against an item (direction affected) or made by an item (direction affecting), from legislation.gov.uk's changes feeds. Filter by the other item (counterpart), by applied status (unapplied = the outstanding work on the revised text), and by provision. item may be partial (ukpga/2018 = all effects on 2018 Acts). Each effect names both sides with provision links, in-force dates, and why it is not applied. For the applied history of one provision in prose, read its annotations with uklaw_get_document.

counterpart.description: Restrict to effects involving this other item (full or partial item path, without a provision, e.g. uksi/2019/419 or uksi/2026) — the amending item for direction affected, the amended item for affecting. A pre-1963 Act takes its calendar year, not its regnal path; drafts are not in the changes feeds.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, passed with the other inputs unchanged; omit for the first page.

direction.description: affected: changes made to item. affecting: changes item makes to other legislation.

item.description: Item path or legislation.gov.uk URI (ukpga/2018/12), or a partial path: a type (uksi) or type and year (ukpga/2018). Get a full path from uklaw_lookup_citation or uklaw_search_legislation. A pre-1963 Act takes its calendar year (ukpga/1925/20, not ukpga/Geo5/15-16/20); its effects name the regnal path, and two sessions in one year can share a number. Drafts (ukdsi, sdsi, nidsr) are not in the changes feeds.

limit.description: Effects per page, or with provision the most matches returned (1–100, default 20).

provision.description: Keep only effects touching this provision of item (path or shorthand, e.g. section/45 or s. 45), including effects on the whole item. Needs a full item path. legislation.gov.uk cannot filter by provision, so each call scans up to 1,500 effects; continue with next_cursor.

status.description: unapplied: effects not yet applied to the revised text; applied: already applied; all: both.

name: uklaw_get_amendments

attribution.description: Attribution lines the returned content requires (OGL always; EU and Westlaw credits when applicable).

effects.description: Effects on this page, most recently modified first; empty when none matched.

items.description: One effect: an amendment, repeal, commencement or modification.

affected.description: The affected legislation and the provisions the effect names on that side.

id_uri.description: Identifier URI of the affected legislation.

item.description: Item path of the affected legislation, e.g. ukpga/2018/12; absent when legislation.gov.uk gives no item URI.

provisions.description: Provisions of the affected legislation, each with its URI; empty for an effect on the whole item.

items.description: One provision or provision range named by the effect.

label.description: Provision as legislation.gov.uk labels it, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)".

missing.description: True when legislation.gov.uk marks the cited provision (or either end of a range) as missing from its data; absent otherwise.

up_to.description: Identifier URI of the last provision of a range such as "s. 65(2)-(4)"; absent for a single provision.

uri.description: Identifier URI of the provision, or of the first provision of a range; absent when legislation.gov.uk records none.

provisions_label.description: Provisions of the affected legislation as one label, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)" or "Sch. 2 para. 3".

affecting.description: The affecting legislation and the provisions the effect names on that side.

id_uri.description: Identifier URI of the affecting legislation.

item.description: Item path of the affecting legislation, e.g. ukpga/2018/12; absent when legislation.gov.uk gives no item URI.

provisions.description: Provisions of the affecting legislation, each with its URI; empty for an effect on the whole item.

items.description: One provision or provision range named by the effect.

label.description: Provision as legislation.gov.uk labels it, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)".

missing.description: True when legislation.gov.uk marks the cited provision (or either end of a range) as missing from its data; absent otherwise.

up_to.description: Identifier URI of the last provision of a range such as "s. 65(2)-(4)"; absent for a single provision.

uri.description: Identifier URI of the provision, or of the first provision of a range; absent when legislation.gov.uk records none.

provisions_label.description: Provisions of the affecting legislation as one label, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)" or "Sch. 2 para. 3".

applied.description: Whether editors have applied the effect to the revised text; absent when legislation.gov.uk does not report it.

commencement_authority.description: Provisions that commence the effect; empty when none are recorded.

items.description: One provision or provision range named by the effect.

label.description: Provision as legislation.gov.uk labels it, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)".

missing.description: True when legislation.gov.uk marks the cited provision (or either end of a range) as missing from its data; absent otherwise.

up_to.description: Identifier URI of the last provision of a range such as "s. 65(2)-(4)"; absent for a single provision.

uri.description: Identifier URI of the provision, or of the first provision of a range; absent when legislation.gov.uk records none.

extent.description: Extent of the affecting provision, e.g. "E+W", or "same as affected"; absent when not recorded.

in_force.description: Commencement entries for the effect; empty when none are recorded.

applied.description: Whether this commencement has been applied to the revised text.

commencing_uri.description: URI of the commencing provision, when recorded.

date.description: In-force date (YYYY-MM-DD); absent when not yet set.

prospective.description: True when the effect has no commencement date yet.

qualification.description: Qualification, e.g. "wholly in force", "for specified purposes".

modified.description: When legislation.gov.uk last modified the effect record, when reported.

notes.description: Reader-facing note, usually why the effect is not applied; absent when none.

outstanding.description: True when the effect requires a text change not reported as applied; an unreported applied or requires_applied counts toward true.

requires_applied.description: False when the effect needs no text change (conditional, superseded, text not held); absent when not reported.

savings.description: Savings provisions attached to the effect; empty when none are recorded.

items.description: One provision or provision range named by the effect.

label.description: Provision as legislation.gov.uk labels it, e.g. "s. 45(2)(f)".

missing.description: True when legislation.gov.uk marks the cited provision (or either end of a range) as missing from its data; absent otherwise.

up_to.description: Identifier URI of the last provision of a range such as "s. 65(2)-(4)"; absent for a single provision.

uri.description: Identifier URI of the provision, or of the first provision of a range; absent when legislation.gov.uk records none.

type.description: Effect type as legislation.gov.uk records it (free text), e.g. "words substituted", "repealed".

welsh_applied.description: Dual-language items: whether the Welsh text has the change.

welsh_requires_applied.description: Dual-language items: whether the Welsh text needs the change.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_item`: item or counterpart is not a (partial) item path or legislation.gov.uk URI, or its type code is unknown, or counterpart carries a provision. `regnal_item`: item or counterpart is a pre-1963 regnal path (ukpga/Geo5/15-16/20, aep/Ann/6): the changes feeds index effects by calendar year and chapter number only. `draft_item`: item or counterpart is draft legislation (ukdsi, sdsi, nidsr), which the changes feeds do not index. `invalid_provision`: provision cannot be normalized. `provision_needs_full_item`: provision is combined with a partial item. `invalid_cursor`: cursor does not decode, belongs to a different query, or holds a position no call over that query reaches (a page past 10,000, or an offset past the end of its page). `filter_refused`: legislation.gov.uk answered the changes feed with 404 or 400: a path or filter combination it does not accept. `upstream_refused`: legislation.gov.uk answered 403 or 429 (its fair use rate limit or a block). `pacer_shed`: The shared request queue cannot start this call within its deadline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True when more effects remain — call again with next_cursor.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to continue; present only when has_more is true.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched or the list continues.

counterpart.description: Counterpart item path; present only when counterpart was given.

provision.description: Provision path filtered on; present only when provision was given.

status.description: Applied-status filter: all, unapplied, or applied.

scan.description: Coverage of this call; present only when filtering by provision.

pages_scanned.description: Pages of 500 effects read by this call.

total_effects.description: Effects legislation.gov.uk holds for the item before the provision filter.

total.description: Total effects legislation.gov.uk holds for this query (before any provision filter).

truncated.description: True when the list was capped at limit.

title: List amendments to or by legislation
